title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive/Researcher - Commercial Fit-Out & Workspace Solutions

Location: Northampton (Office-Based)
Salary: 28,000 - 40,000 (DOE) + Performance related bonus (OTE 10k, uncapped)

Hours: Monday to Friday 07:30am - 4:30pm (Flexibility as required)

Holidays: 22 days + additional 1 day birthday leave + statutory

Are you naturally curious, commercially minded, and skilled at uncovering opportunities others miss? Do you enjoy researching businesses, building relationships, and playing a key role in driving growth without the pressure of a traditional hard-sales environment?

If this sounds like you, a leading specialist in commercial warehouse and industrial fit-out solutions is looking for a Business Development Executive / Researcher to join their growing team.

About the Company

This ambitious and fast-growing business delivers turnkey warehouse, logistics and office fit-out projects across the UK. Working with organisations in the logistics, warehousing and manufacturing sectors, they help businesses transform and scale their operational spaces quickly and efficiently. With significant growth plans and increasing demand for their services, they are investing heavily in their business development capabilities to support the next stage of expansion.

What's the Role About?

This is not your typical business development position.

You'll focus on identifying future opportunities before projects are actively being tendered, using a combination of research, prospecting and relationship-building activities to create a strong pipeline for the commercial team.

You'll:
- Research and identify businesses that fit the ideal customer profile.
- Build relationships with senior decision-makers across target organisations.
- Generate qualified opportunities and meetings for the sales team.
- Gather valuable market intelligence and commercial insight.
- Position the business as the preferred partner when future projects arise.

Key Responsibilities
- Research and qualify prospective customers across logistics, warehousing, manufacturing and industrial sectors.
- Use CRM platforms, LinkedIn and prospecting tools to identify key contacts and opportunities.
- Conduct outbound phone, email and LinkedIn outreach to directors, owners and senior decision-makers.
- Generate Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and support the progression of opportunities through the sales funnel.
- Build detailed account profiles including ownership structures, growth plans and operational requirements.
- Nurture long-term relationships with prospects and referral partners.
- Maintain accurate CRM records, activity reporting and pipeline updates.
- Identify early buying signals and future project opportunities ahead of competitors.

Requirements

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Confident communicating with senior stakeholders and business leaders.
- Naturally inquisitive with strong research and investigative skills.
- Organised, detail-oriented and comfortable managing multiple opportunities.
- Resilient and professional when conducting outbound outreach.
- Relationship-focused and commercially aware.
- Motivated by targets, growth and delivering measurable outcomes.

Experience in business development, lead generation, appointment setting, account management or sales support would be advantageous, although attitude, curiosity and drive are equally important. Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM systems or prospecting tools would also be beneficial.

Benefits

What's in it for you?
- Join a growing business with ambitious expansion plans.
- Clear progression opportunities into Business Development, Sales or Account Management.
- Work closely with senior leadership and gain valuable commercial exposure.
- Competitive salary with performance-related bonus potential.
- Supportive, collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment.
- Opportunity to develop highly transferable sales, research and relationship-management skills.

If you're looking for a role where your research skills, commercial awareness and relationship-building ability can make a direct impact on business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today or get in touch for a confidential conversation about this exciting opportunity.

title: Internal Sales & Account Management Executive

Internal Sales & Account Management Executive
Location: Northampton, NN6

Hours: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm
Job Type: Permanent, full-time
The Opportunity
We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established global manufacturing business in the metalworking industry. Due to the continued needs of the business, they are looking for an organised, commercially minded and proactive Internal Sales & Account Management Executive to join their busy, close-knit team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in internal sales, sales administration or customer account management who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.
Supporting customers, external sales representatives and international markets across the UK, Ireland, Israel and Denmark, you'll play a key role in ensuring orders are processed efficiently, stock is managed effectively and customers receive an exceptional level of service.
Please note: This is more than a straightforward sales administration position. The role involves complex order management, technical product information, stock forecasting and problem-solving, so the successful candidate will need to be adaptable, proactive and confident managing competing priorities.

What's in it for you?
- Hybrid working: The option to work from home one day per week following successful completion of probation.
- Early Friday finish: A four-weekly rolling rota, allowing you to finish at 1:30pm on Fridays, with a reduced 30-minute lunch break to ensure contracted hours are completed. Available following probation.
- Bonus scheme: The opportunity to earn up to 18% of your annual salary through a performance-related sales incentive scheme, subject to achieving objectives.
- Annual leave: 26 days of annual holiday, plus bank holidays. The Christmas shutdown is provided without the need to use annual leave.
- Pension: Generous employer pension contribution of 10%.
- Training: Comprehensive training and ongoing support to help you develop your product and system knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage internal sales activities and maintain strong relationships with existing customer accounts.
- Process customer orders and enquiries using SAP and AI-supported platforms.
- Monitor orders, resolve queries and manage back orders to ensure timely delivery.
- Liaise with external suppliers to purchase additional materials and products when required.
- Manage material creation, product information and master data accuracy.
- Oversee consignment stock, inventory levels and stock forecasting.
- Work closely with external sales representatives to support customer requirements and account needs.
- Communicate with customers via telephone, email and Microsoft Teams, providing efficient and professional service.
- Prepare customs documentation, proforma invoices and other relevant warehouse paperwork.
- Identify and resolve order, stock and delivery issues, taking ownership through to resolution.
- Support customers across multiple international markets, ensuring accurate and timely communication.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience in internal sales, sales order processing, sales administration or account management.
- Experience using SAP would be highly advantageous due to the complexity of the system.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- A confident telephone manner and professional communication skills.
- The ability to think quickly, solve problems and use initiative.
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a small team.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- The ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise competing demands.
- Experience dealing with international customers would be beneficial.
- Experience supporting Danish-speaking or Danish-based customers would be an advantage, but is not essential.
- Full and comprehensive training will be provided. However, due to the fast-paced nature of the team, the ability to learn quickly and become confident in the role is essential.

If you have a background in internal sales, customer account management or sales order processing and are looking for a role offering variety, responsibility and a strong benefits package, we?d love to hear from you.
Apply today to find out more!
The successful candidate will ideally be available to start as soon as possible.
